page_title: LEV 4-1 HEI | Bayer Leverkusen v Heidenheim 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 20:1.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for an infringement.
87' Omar Traore (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lukas Hradecky, who smothers the ball.
85' Substitution. Alejandro Grimaldo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
85' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Victor Boniface is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' 4 - 1 GOAL - 4:1! Alejandro Grimaldo found Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Kevin Muller off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Eren Dinkci will be replaced by Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
82' Substitution. Tim Kleindienst will be replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
82' Here is a change. Jan-Niklas Beste is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
79' A substitution has been made. Jeremie Frimpong is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
79' Bayer Leverkusen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort rattles the left post! What a shot that was!
74' 3 - 1 Goal! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Kevin Muller into middle of the goal.
74' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is going to take the penalty!
74' The Bayer Leverkusen players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
74' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen! Let's see what he decides.

73' PENALTY APPEAL after Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

73' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Kevin Muller, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

73' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
71' Here's the change. Exequiel Palacios leaves the pitch and Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as a substitute.
71' Florian Wirtz will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
69' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Pick (Heidenheim) replacing Norman Theuerkauf.
68' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
66' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
63' Substitution. Nikola Dovedan walks off the pitch and Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.

63' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
58' 1 - 1 Goal! Jan-Niklas Beste tees up Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:1.

57' A neat pass is well received by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
52' Surely that's handball by one of the Heidenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
49' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
49' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
49' A cross from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
47' Lukas Hradecky leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim).

47' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Heidenheim.
47' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Heidenheim.
46' Referee Christian Dingert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Kevin Muller makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner.
42' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) was too forceful with his tackle and Christian Dingert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
36' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
34' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) for his blatant foul.
30' What a big chance! Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.
29' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul. Christian Dingert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
26' Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar.
25' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

25' What an amazing save by Kevin Muller! Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the top right corner, but fails. Bayer Leverkusen have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
20' Christian Dingert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) and blew his whistle.
17' The corner from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared away by the defence.

17' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
15' Flag up against Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
14' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

14' Jeremie Frimpong almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

9' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Exequiel Palacios slips the ball through to Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
6' Bayer Leverkusen can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' A great run by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender. Bayer Leverkusen force their opponents to concede a corner.
4' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
3' The referee blows his whistle after Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Heidenheim win a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
